title: Add alias rows for the Gentoo area (gentoo linux, portage, emerge, ebuild, stage3, binhost, eselect)
goal: Add these rows to _tools/aliases.csv (term,canonical): gentoo linux,gentoo; portage,gentoo; emerge,gentoo; ebuild,gentoo; stage3,gentoo; binhost,gentoo; eselect,gentoo. The Gentoo topics are security/gentoo-use-flags-profiles-keywords, security/gentoo-emerge-make-conf-etc-portage, security/gentoo-ebuild-repositories-overlays, security/gentoo-binary-packages-binhost and security/gentoo-stage-files-init-systems.

run: import sys; sys.exit(0 if 'portage,gentoo' in open('_tools/aliases.csv').read().split() or any(l.strip()=='portage,gentoo' for l in open('_tools/aliases.csv')) else 1)
